failedCondition3Wording: In the first figure, paint node 1 black. Conditions 1 and 2 hold, and θ=−s_1 is an involution that permutes the roots, but condition 3 fails: at node 2 the number is −1/2. Yet no involution of the Lie algebra sl(3) acts as this θ on its Cartan subalgebra and fixes the root vectors of node 1: the natural candidate, from the Chevalley involution and a matrix for w_X, has order 4, verified by computation, and the formula of beat 5 would give dim k equal to 5, while the real forms of A_2 have 3, 4 and 8. So this decoration is not the Satake diagram of any real form, and the Studio shows no data for it. [E15:] The same permutation of the roots does occur for a real form, sl(3,R), on its maximally compact Cartan subalgebra, where the fixed root is imaginary and non-compact; Vogan diagrams are built on such Cartan subalgebras.
